verdict.rationale: Sentry has automation-like features, such as alert rules, Seer Autofix and coding-agent handoffs, so versioning and rollback of automations is a fair question. But the evidence shows no version history, review workflow, or rollback for them. The release management (sentry-cli releases) and dotagents version locking are about application releases and agent skill dependencies, not versioning automations, so they earn no credit.
